summary: Both phases were delivered as planned. Phase-01 extracted readActiveRulepacks and rejectDuplicateRuleIds, implemented DoctrineModule.check with the resolveWorkspacePolicy shared prefix, added human/JSON renders, registered --for/--check either-or CLI, and regenerated the usage spec and CLI docs — with error-order precedence, all invariant suites, and the 11-case e2e test confirmed. Phase-02 made guide resolution in query lazy (root, matched scope, matched concepts only), rewrote the two posture comments, replaced e2e case (9) with (9a)–(9d), and split the guide-refusal capability test into surfaced (still refuses) and unsurfaced (exists never called, asserted via call log). All planned files were touched in the correct phases; the one optional edit (contracts/index.ts) was justified; no unplanned files were modified; both commit subjects match the plan verbatim; and all invariant suites passed unmodified.

findings.message: loadActiveRulepacks does not internally call the batch readActiveRulepacks — it keeps its own per-ref read→parse→skill-refusal loop to preserve error-order precedence. This is documented in the handoff as a deliberate decision, not a deviation.
All three optional files (program.ts, steme.usage.kdl, docs/cli.md) were left untouched; justified in the handoff because --for's option description never mentioned guide validation.
